ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the upper part of the figure there is a horseshoe magnet marked “magnet”; the left magnetic pole is marked N, and the right magnetic pole is marked S, with a vertically placed copper disk clamped in the middle; the copper disk passes through a horizontal axis wire, and the two ends of the axis wire are marked O1 and O2. Then reason: This device is a Faraday disk induction generator. When the copper disk rotates around the axis in the magnetic field, the free charges in the disk are separated along the radial direction under the action of the Lorentz force, so the induced electromotive force is produced between the axis center of the copper disk and the edge of the disk. To make there be an induced current in the ammeter, the two ends of the ammeter must be connected respectively to the axis wire terminal and to the brush point at the edge of the copper disk. According to the positions given in the figure, M should be connected to O1, and N to a.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中磁铁的N、S极夹着一只可绕水平轴线转动的铜盘，铜盘边缘标有可接触电刷点a、b、c、d，轴线导线两端标为O1、O2，下面电流表有接线端M、N。再读题：要求铜盘转动时，为观察感应电流，选择电流表两端分别连接的位置。推理时把装置识别为法拉第圆盘/感应式发电机：铜盘在沿轴线方向的磁场中转动，盘内自由电荷受洛伦兹力作用沿半径方向分离，因此感应电动势产生在铜盘中心轴线与盘边缘之间；若电流表两端都接在轴线导线或都接在边缘等势处，不能形成有效感应电流。故应将电流表一端接轴线导线端O1，另一端接盘边缘电刷点a，即M接O1，N接a。
